Problem with passwords is people forget them, and reusing passwords makes everything hinge on only that one point.

So instead of trying to memorize a dozen or more big long passwords, just use an algorithm. Take something unique to the service you're using and modify it a few simple ways, then all you need to memorize is the steps you used.

For example:

  • Start with the name of the site or service
  • Increase the length by repeating it 3x
  • Break it up into groups of 5 letters
  • If the final group isn't a full 5, add X until it is
  • Reverse each group individually
  • At the end of each group, number the vowels in it

"AAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA" is not a great password for other reasons, though. It's reasonably difficult to type, because you have to smack the A key a specific number of times.
